description: Land Acquisition - Thalpawila North, Matara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose (the proposed Matara-Kataragama Railway Line). It provides detailed descriptions of the specific land parcels, their extents, and boundaries. The content is entirely focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related administrative actions.
